title: Ascend NPU性能优化规则
description: Ascend NPU上的关键性能优化规则

rules.name: continuous_access
rules.description: 尽量使用连续内存访问
rules.rationale: 连续访问带宽利用率最高

rules.name: avoid_load_other
rules.rationale: 会阻止MTE独立执行，影响流水线

rules.name: token_parallelism
rules.rationale: 减少循环次数，提升效率

examples.good:
# 连续访问
offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
x = tl.load(ptr + offsets)
